hypothesis.title: Foreign Investor Order Flow and Next-Day Returns on the Vietnamese Equity Market
hypothesis.statement: Net foreign buying on a Vietnamese trading day predicts a higher VN-Index return on the next trading day.
hypothesis.null_hypothesis: The coefficient of the next-day VN-Index return on the foreign flow imbalance is zero.
hypothesis.alt_hypothesis: The coefficient is positive (HAC one-sided p < 0.05 and circular-shift placebo p < 0.05).
hypothesis.methodology: Predictive regression with Newey-West HAC errors and circular-shift placebo
hypothesis.metric_name: beta of next-day VN-Index return on foreign flow imbalance
hypothesis.summary_findings: beta=0.0010, HAC t=0.64 (p=0.2610), placebo p=0.3068, contemporaneous corr 0.13.
